en: Isolate or mark the affected plants.
Take the leaf photo to your nearest agricultural extension officer to confirm.
Avoid moving plant material from affected plants to healthy ones.
Keep scouting your field regularly, especially after rain.
Ask your agro-dealer about a recommended fungicide.
Rotate crops next season and avoid planting maize in the same field.
Monitor how fast the rust spreads to new leaves.
Ask your agro-dealer about a suitable fungicide if spread is fast.
Water at the base of the plant, not over the leaves.
Ask your agro-dealer about a recommended fungicide.
Remove and destroy infected plants quickly, it spreads fast in wet weather.
